tools.name: risk_desk_status
tools.description: Check the Risk Desk data mode, the public example, the size limits and the sign convention before requesting any figure. No market data feed, no broker connection and no hosted XVA exist.

tools.name: risk_tail
tools.description: Historical VaR and Expected Shortfall over supplied horizon P&L. Report degraded status and the loss sign convention before the numbers. Omit the request to run the public synthetic energy example instead. For supplied data, require permission and set rights_confirmed=true; this does not verify a li

tools.name: risk_exposure
tools.description: Gross and net exposure, leverage against NAV and concentration for signed linear positions in one stated base currency. Omit the request to run the public synthetic energy example instead. For supplied data, require permission and set rights_confirmed=true; this does not verify a licence.

tools.name: risk_stress
tools.description: Apply explicit asset shocks to all linear positions. No scenario probability is inferred or attached. Omit the request to run the public synthetic energy example instead. For supplied data, require permission and set rights_confirmed=true; this does not verify a licence.

tools.name: risk_tail_models
tools.description: VaR and ES side by side: historical, normal, Student-t, EVT, GARCH filtered historical, GARCH-EVT and GARCH-t. Omit the request to run the shipped synthetic example instead. For supplied data, require permission and set rights_confirmed=true; this does not verify a licence.

tools.name: risk_backtest
tools.description: Backtest a VaR (and optional ES) series against realised P&L: Kupiec, Christoffersen, Basel zone and Acerbi-Szekely Z2.
